verdict.rationale: Claude Code's overview docs name both parts of this story: visual diff review and running multiple sessions side by side. The VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin add inline and interactive diff viewing. The support rests on one short line, though, and the quoted snippet never names the surface as a desktop app. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that these features live in a desktop app, in-depth docs on the diff-review UI and side-by-side session management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions.
The VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history directly in your editor.
interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing
Available for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
